title: 2024 Panini Prizm Draft Picks - Campus Legends Green Prizm #3 Kevin Durant
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a 2024 Panini Prizm Draft Picks trading card featuring Kevin Durant from the Texas Longhorns in the NCAA. It is a Green Prizm parallel card, part of the Campus Legends insert set. This card is numbered 3 in the set and is manufactured by Panini.
